faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Project Assistant - Research position at IIT Kharagpur?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Project Assistant - Research post at IIT Kharagpur is 03-09-2026. Ensure you apply well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum qualifications required for the Project Assistant - Research role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelors degree in science or a 3 years Diploma in Engineering & Technology to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category of candidates applying for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Project Assistant - Research position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Assistant - Research post is 35 years. Age relaxation may be applicable as per sponsor agency rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant - Research role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of up to Rs.27000, which may vary based on qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Project Assistant - Research post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Assistant - Research position at IIT Kharagpur.

faq.question: Q7. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: This is a project-based job, meaning the employment is tied to the duration and funding of the specific research project.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is IIT/SRIC/R/UCP/2026/101.

faq.question: Q9. What is the primary focus of the research project for which this position is advertised?
faq.answer: The research project focuses on Sustainable Hydrogen from Hybrid Biogas Reforming, funded by ANRF.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification and the apply online link in the "Important Links" section of this article, which will direct you to the relevant pages on the IIT Kharagpur website.
